summary_en: First-corporation will acquire 372,300 treasury shares (2.79% of outstanding shares) at no cost and cancel them on September 30, 2026, following the termination of its employee stock ownership plan trust (J-ESOP) on August 10, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Shares at No Cost in Connection with Termination of Employee Stock Ownership Plan Trust
translation_en_brief:
First-corporation has decided to acquire and cancel 372,300 treasury shares (2.79% of outstanding shares) at no cost, effective September 30, 2026. The action arises from the termination of the company's employee stock ownership plan trust (J-ESOP), which was introduced in March 2019 in partnership with Mizuho Trust & Banking. The trust was terminated on August 10, 2026, in accordance with the plan's provisions.

Under the trust agreement, the residual assets consisting of 372,300 ordinary shares are being transferred to the company as trustor. Pursuant to Article 155(13) of the Companies Act and Article 27(1) of the Companies Act Enforcement Regulations, the company will acquire these shares without consideration from Japan Custody Bank (as trustee) on September 15, 2026, and proceed to cancel them on September 30, 2026.
